diagnosis: Check C6, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (the 0800 Dock 1 appointment), passed in rollouts 0 and 2 despite the models never having access to PF1. In these rollouts, the models correctly identified that 'carrier_coordination_required' must be true, likely due to a narrative stereotype or pattern-matching regarding 'time-limited temperature-controlled delivery' mentioned in the public facts.

C6.why: The confirmed 0800 Dock 1 appointment changes the medical unloading start to exactly 0800 at Dock 1. Because the carrier will hold the temperature-controlled load only until 1000 and the appointment is not yet on the battalion movement board, the distribution platoon must coordinate directly with the carrier; updating the movement board alone does not satisfy this requirement.
